frameIndexPrecision: Estimated from recorded presentation timestamp; original cached observations have no exact decoded frame IDs.
timeMapping: Original sample.tMs remains relative to the unchanged opening.mp4. sourceTimeSeconds = 1 + tMs / 1000.
provenance: Actual independent local MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite float16 v1 CPU inference on preserved 24.mp4 teaching clips. All 33 observed Pose landmarks retained. Recorded teacher data, not a live camera result. No interpolation, synthetic endpoints or wrist/ankle extrapolation. Derived palm/foot centers are calculated separately by the practice page.
samplingPolicy: Infer each original 12 Hz presentation timestamp in ascending order after seeking its decoded source frame (+0.001 seconds; final request clamped before clip end). Each source uses a fresh model. Frame indices retain the archived estimated provenance; they are not new exact decoded-frame IDs.
presencePolicy: Preserved only when actually supplied by MediaPipe; omitted otherwise.
